tool_args.rationale: The previous execution error came from referencing an undefined training-row variable in prediction. This implementation numerically fits the four barrier/sink parameters in fit(train_rows), stores them, and predicts from that fit. The available s_grad span exceeds the stated trigger for an open-branch probe, so no additional measurement is indicated.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The source note only calls for it when s_grad span is below 0.08; the five training rows span 0.25 to 2.25.
No evidence indicates trajectory resolution is needed; the specified four-parameter law is numerically fit-able from the supplied rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Tafel exponential or Haldane substrate-inhibition models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The recalled barrier/sink signatures and source note provide a directly testable mechanism matching the varied inputs; these alternatives are less consistent with the evidence.
